verdict.rationale:
Segment's Sources catalog and Connections pipeline explicitly support pulling data from third-party apps like Shopify (segment-intdir-5), plus Reverse ETL for warehouse data and Functions for building custom sources to bring in new data types (segment-docs-7, segment-docs-5/30). This goes beyond just instrumenting one's own apps via analytics.track calls.

missing for 10: a fuller list/count of pre-built third-party app sources beyond the single Shopify example, and independent/hands-on confirmation of ease of setting up third-party source connectors.
